panels.rationale: Single-panel bedside chest radiograph of a real patient from an article titled 'Giant compressive emphysema: a rare complication of COVID-19' (primary disease emphysema). The film shows a markedly hyperlucent (dark) hemithorax with mediastinal deviation away from it, consistent with the giant compressive emphysematous bulla/hyperlucency of emphysema; the arrows are figure annotations. Findings are limited because the caption (which inconsistently labels the CT/radiograph and the sides) only explicitly describes 'clarity of the ... lung except at the apex'; bulla terminology in the provided vocabulary is CT-specific, so the giant bulla is proposed rather than tagged.
